verdict.rationale: Shopify's own docs say developers use the official Shopify CLI to scaffold POS UI extensions, so an official CLI does exist for this product. Its documented scope is narrow, though: extension scaffolding only, with no evidence it can operate POS itself (orders, inventory, staff) or that it is designed for AI-native or agent workflows. Missing for 10: CLI commands for managing POS data and operations, AI- or agent-oriented CLI features, in-depth CLI reference docs for POS, independent or hands-on corroboration.
